figures.finding: The fund open to Palestinian filmmakers is the Palestine Film Fund, launched by the Palestine Film Institute (an independent institute, not a state body) in May 2025, for Palestinians wherever they live: grants of EUR 3,000 to 15,000; for medium and feature-length films up to EUR 5,000 for development and EUR 15,000 for post-production, with production costs not eligible; amounts at the selection committee's discretion.
figures.applies: Palestinian filmmakers anywhere; fall cycle 2025/26, read 2026-11-01.

sources.said: Launched by the Palestine Film Institute in May 2025, the Palestine Film Fund provides essential financial and professional support for Palestinian filmmakers worldwide, regardless of where they live or what passport they carry. … through grants ranging from €3,000 to €15,000 … Medium- and Feature-length Films (over 30 minutes) Development: up to €5,000 (research, concept design, writing, visual references, early creative planning, script development) Post-production: up to €15,000 (editing, sound design, color grading, festival submission packaging) Production costs are not eligible Grant amounts are allocated at the discretion of the selection committee, based on submitted budgets, timeline and feasibility.

figures.finding: The Ministry of Culture's Palestinian Cultural Fund supports projects in cinema and audiovisual among other fields; the Ministry's 2023 film policy proposes a Palestine Film Commission and a Palestine Film Fund for production, capacity-building and marketing.
figures.applies: State of Palestine, reported 2020 (PCF) and 2023 (film policy)

sources.said: supporting projects in the different fields such as theater, cinema, audiovisual and visual arts, music, performing arts and literature
